Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.gwc

Class GwcLayerManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.gwc.GwcLayerManager
public class GwcLayerManager extends AbstractManager
GeoWebCache (GWC) Layer REST API client.

Source: geowebcache/rest/src/main/java/org/geowebcache/rest/controller/TileLayerController.java
GeoServer integrated GWC path: /geoserver/gwc/rest/layers

Endpoints (5)


 [1] GET    /gwc/rest/layers              list all tile layers           200
 [2] GET    /gwc/rest/layers/{name}       get tile layer details         200 / 404
 [3] POST   /gwc/rest/layers/{name}       add layer (deprecated)         200
 [4] PUT    /gwc/rest/layers/{name}       create or update (upsert)      200 / 201
 [5] DELETE /gwc/rest/layers/{name}       delete layer and tile cache    200 / 404

GET [1] observed (2026-07-29): returns a plain string array ["ne:vworld_2d_map"] — not {name, href} objects (contrary to some GWC Javadoc).

GET [2] observed (2026-07-29) response shape: 


 {"GeoServerLayer":{
   "name":"ne:vworld_2d_map","enabled":true,"inMemoryCached":true,"id":"LayerInfoImpl--...",
   "mimeFormats":["image/png","image/jpeg"],
   "gridSubsets":[{"gridSetName":"EPSG:4326"},{"gridSetName":"EPSG:900913"}],
   "parameterFilters":[{"defaultValue":"","key":"STYLES"}],
   "metaWidthHeight":[4,4],"expireCache":0,"expireClients":0,"gutter":0,"cacheWarningSkips":[]
 }}

JSON PUT bug: JSON PUT causes an XStream "Duplicate field" 500. upsert(String, GwcLayer) always uses XML.

DELETE also removes the tile cache.

[4] PUT /gwc/rest/layers/{name} — expireCache / expireClients special values


 -1 = never expire
 -2 = disable
 -3 = use HTTP headers from the WMS backend
 -4 = unset

In GeoServer integrated mode, the GeoServer layer must already exist before PUT succeeds [server-verified]. parameterFilters are returned in GET responses — see GwcLayer.

    • list

      public List<String> list()

    • get

      public GwcLayer get(String layer)
      Returns tile layer details. Layer name format: workspace:name.

      GeoServer bug (2026-07-29, GeoServer 2.28.2 / GWC 1.28.2): returns 500 "Unknown layer: {name}" instead of 404 when the layer is not registered. Both cases are mapped to GwcLayerNotFoundException.

      Throws:
      GwcLayerNotFoundException - if the layer is not registered in GWC

    • upsert

      public void upsert(String layerName, GwcLayer request)
      Creates or updates a tile layer (upsert). Always serialized as XML — JSON PUT causes an XStream 500 on GeoServer 2.28.2. Only works for layers that already exist in GeoServer's catalog.
